exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time WITH offset, e.g. 2026-11-08T08:30:00+05:30. Use +05:30 (IST) unless the source document says otherwise.

metric.description: Fixed units: bloodPressure=mmHg, glucose=mg/dL, weight=kg, temperature=°F, pulse=bpm, spo2=%, respiratoryRate=breaths/min. Convert other units first (mmol/L x 18 = mg/dL; °C x 9/5 + 32 = °F; lb / 2.2046 = kg).

context.description: Only for glucose: fasting, postMeal (2h after food) or random. Defaults to random when omitted.

readings.description: One or more readings taken at the same time.

oneOf.title: Custom test
oneOf.description: Any test not in the catalogue. Requires name; give unit and the report range if printed.

name.description: REQUIRED for custom tests: the test name as printed. Optional (ignored) for catalogue tests.

value.description: Numeric result, ALREADY CONVERTED to the test's canonical unit. Exactly one of value or text.

qualifier.description: Use when the report prints "<2.0" or ">1000": put the number in value and "<" or ">" here.

text.description: Non-numeric result as printed, e.g. "Negative", "Non-reactive", "6-8 /HPF". Exactly one of value or text.

abnormal.description: Only for text results: true if the report marks it abnormal. Numeric results are flagged automatically from the range.

unit.description: Catalogue tests: omit, or give the canonical unit exactly. Custom tests: the unit as printed.

refLow.description: Lower limit of the reference range PRINTED ON THE REPORT (canonical unit). Overrides the catalogue range.

refHigh.description: Upper limit of the reference range PRINTED ON THE REPORT (canonical unit). For "< 37" use refHigh 37.

results.description: All results from one report / sample collection.

oneOf.description: Lab report: one sample collection with its results. timestamp = sample collection time.

entries.description: All timeline entries for this patient, any order (the app sorts by timestamp).

id.description: Unique within the file. UUID recommended; any short unique string such as "e_001" is accepted. Used to match records on merge.

times.description: Local clock times each scheduled day, 24h "HH:MM" in IST. "Every 2 hours" must be expanded into explicit times.

startDate.description: First day the task applies, YYYY-MM-DD. Every scheduled occurrence from this date with no outcome entry counts as OVERDUE, so set it to today (or the first unresolved day) unless you also supply outcomes for past occurrences.

endDate.description: Last day, inclusive. Omit if ongoing.

items.description: A recurring care need with a schedule.

tasks.description: Recurring task definitions. Use [] if none.

description: One patient with profile, timeline entries (vitals, lab results, medications, observations, appointments, photos, task outcomes) and recurring tasks. India-first: IST (+05:30), mg/dL, °F, kg, cm, +91; lab values in each test's canonical unit. Not expressible in JSON Schema (the app also checks): entry ids unique; task ids unique; every task entry taskId matches a tasks[].id; lab refLow <= refHigh. Agent guide: ../agent/AGENTS.md
